what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the tools in tools/how-someone-does-their-thing: what each tool does, what it takes and gives back, and how it runs.

payload.label: Brief a profile of how someone does their thing
payload.job: Work out how a person or creator does their thing, such as their style or voice, from what they have made or said
payload.description: Give the profile's name, the subject's name and the subject's own records (what they made or said). Returns what you need to derive the profile: the records, the rules for the answer and the shape of the answer. It asks no model; you derive the items, then give them to tool:keep-a-profile. An empty list of records is refused.

profile_ref.description: The name the profile record will be kept under

subject_ref.description: Whose way of doing the thing this is

subject_records.description: What the subject made or said, read from their records

instruction.description: An extra rule for the answer, if any

verify.contains: Use only the supplied subject records.

payload.label: Keep a profile of how someone does their thing
payload.job: Keep the profile of how a person does their thing, so drafts made for them are shaped by it and checked against it
payload.description: Give the profile's name, the subject's name, the items you derived (a non-empty list of objects) and, as refs, the feature schemas, evaluators, generators and validation policy that go with it. Returns and keeps one profile record under the profile's name; keeping it again replaces it. Empty items, or a ref that is not a non-empty string, are refused.

validation_policy_ref.description: One ref, or the gate and the spec the gate judges by

payload.label: Check a draft carries its profile
payload.job: Check that a draft made for a person carries the references to the profile that shaped it and the profile it is checked by
payload.description: Give the draft (a list of blocks, each an object), the names of the fields that must carry a profile reference, and optionally the profile's name. A field passes when some block of the draft holds a non-empty value in it, and, when you gave the profile's name, when one of those values is that name. Returns whether the draft fits and, for each field, whether it passed and why not. It judges references only, not the words.

payload.label: Read how someone writes
payload.job: Read how this person writes before drafting anything for them: a post, an email, a message
payload.description: Read BEFORE you draft for this person. Returns how_to_use, the profile fields, the voice profiles saved so far (one per kind of writing), their newest edits to words an AI wrote (each with the draft as it was, before, and their words, after) and words they published (sent). Give kind to read one kind's profile and edits; limit is how many edits (1 to 50). Writes nothing.

kind.description: What is written, like post or email; leave out for every kind (or, saving, the general profile)

provenance.source: Trillion-X/trillion src/voice.mjs (the person's writing voice, learned from what they change), moved here; reads and writes the person's voice-edit and voice-profile records through the records door

payload.label: Save how someone writes
payload.job: Save what you learned about how this person writes, for one kind of writing
payload.description: Saves what you learned from tool:read-voice as the voice profile of one kind of writing (kind, like post or email; leave out for a general one). fields are named by tool:read-voice's fields list; a field you give replaces that field, an empty one removes it, and the rest are kept. builds_on names the kinds of the profiles this one sits on, earliest first. Pass expected_set_at (the set_at you read) so a profile saved since is not overwritten. by is person only when the person saved it themselves. Returns profile and said.

kind.description: What is written, like post or email; leave out for every kind (or, saving, the general profile)

provenance.source: Trillion-X/trillion src/voice.mjs (the person's writing voice, learned from what they change), moved here; reads and writes the person's voice-edit and voice-profile records through the records door

record_model._what: The record kinds, indexes and links this tool keeps (moved unchanged from trillion-rust's one record model: src/record_model_policy/record-model.json, src/record_indexes/record-indexes.json, product/lists.json field_kinds and product/record-sharing.json links).

kinds._read_by: src/voice.mjs: what an AI learned about how the person writes, one per kind of writing

payload.label: Forget how someone writes
payload.job: Forget part of what is kept about how this person writes
payload.description: Forgets one profile (profile_id from tool:read-voice), one edit (edit_id from tool:read-voice), or every edit (all_edits true, with kind to forget only one kind's). Returns forgot (how many) and said.

kind.description: What is written, like post or email; leave out for every kind (or, saving, the general profile)

provenance.source: Trillion-X/trillion src/voice.mjs (the person's writing voice, learned from what they change), moved here; reads and writes the person's voice-edit and voice-profile records through the records door

payload.label: Keep the person's edit of an AI's words
payload.job: Keep what the person changed in words an AI wrote for them, so their voice is learned from it
payload.description: Run when the person themselves changed words an AI wrote (a draft's caption): kind (like post), subject_id (what was edited), before (the AI's words), after (theirs) and before_by (the AI that wrote them). Nothing is kept when the words did not really change. Only the newest edits are kept. Returns edit, or edit null.

kind.description: What is written, like post or email; leave out for every kind (or, saving, the general profile)

provenance.source: Trillion-X/trillion src/voice.mjs (the person's writing voice, learned from what they change), moved here; reads and writes the person's voice-edit and voice-profile records through the records door

record_model._what: The record kinds, indexes and links this tool keeps (moved unchanged from trillion-rust's one record model: src/record_model_policy/record-model.json, src/record_indexes/record-indexes.json, product/lists.json field_kinds and product/record-sharing.json links).

kinds._read_by: src/voice.mjs: what the person changed in words an AI wrote (before and after), newest kept

payload.label: Find the edits a person repeats
payload.job: Find the word changes a person keeps making to drafts written for them
payload.description: Counts, over the person's kept edits handed in as edits (kind narrows them), the words removed, added or replaced, each once per draft, and returns the changes found in at least min_distinct_drafts different drafts (3 when left out, never below 2), each with an example edit_id. They are proposals to show the person before saving any into a profile with tool:save-voice. Reads and keeps nothing: the person's AI reads the voice-edit records from its store and sends them.

kind.description: What is written, like post or email; leave out for every kind (or, saving, the general profile)

edits.description: The person's voice-edit values, each { edit_id, kind, subject_id?, before, after } (subject_id names the draft; without it each edit is its own draft)

provenance.source: Trillion-X/trillion src/voice.mjs (the person's writing voice, learned from what they change), moved here; finds repeats over the edits it is handed and keeps nothing
